title: Walsh-Domain Reference-Based ECG Anomaly Detection: Reproducible Code and Verification Package
description: Reference implementation and reproducibility package for the manuscript 'Interpretable ECG Anomaly Scoring in Walsh-Hadamard Coordinates: Orthogonal Invariance and Exact Time-Domain Score Decomposition'. The package verifies orthogonal invariance, exact detector-relative score decomposition, multilead max-fusion, and the associated reproducibility workflow. The synthetic verification run is intended for methodological verification and does not claim clinical validation.
